findings.explanation: A signed-in user can change the protected column "role" on their own row in the table "members".
findings.fix: Stop users from updating "role" on "members": take update permission on that column away from the signed-in role (revoke update, then grant update only on the columns users may change), or move it to a table users cannot write.

proof.statement: UPDATE "public"."members" SET "role" = 'admin' WHERE "role" IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin'
